mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that will drag on GDP growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth > 10% and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (proxied by PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 200k for 3 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (proxied by CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year for two consecutive months, it signals a rising inflationary environment that will pressure the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL y-o-y growth > 3% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y growth > 3% for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) decline month-over-month for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will pressure corporate earnings and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines m-o-m for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: RSAFS declines m-o-m for 3 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
